title: Constructible compositor data and normalized realization interface
statement: The existing normalized realization comparisons, coefficient equation, finite and integral left compositors, exceptional mate construction and its properties are the data used by [lem-sf-constructible-exceptional-compositor]. They are defined using the exact constructible coefficient categories of [lem-sf-constructible-exceptional-adjunction-coefficients] and the finite maps of [def-sf-finite-exceptional-compositor-maps]. No compositor existence or coherence theorem is part of these definitions. In addition, for every finite coefficient stage and six-operation datum S [sk-def-sf-operations], every separated finite-type morphism f and compactification c of f, the integral compact-support operation of S at f and c equals the normalized finite-action integral functor of [def-weil-compact-support-finite-action] (constructibleIntegralSupport_eq).

Full-subcategory faithfulness and functor extensionality give equality of the normalized functors.

lean.statement:
theorem constructibleIntegralSupport_eq
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (B : D.CoefficientDatum)
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic B.l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic B.l) E] (n : ℕ+) (S : SixFunctorOperationDatum D B E n n.pos)
    {X Y : SixFunctorSpace D} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsSeparated f.hom.left] [LocallyOfFiniteType f.hom.left] [QuasiCompact f.hom.left]
    (c : Compactification f.hom.left) :
    S.higher.integral.support f c =
      sfCompactSupportFiniteIntegralFunctor B.l D.k
        (PurCompactSupport.coefficientPrimeUnit B.l D B.different) c E
